class.name: BakedFogVolume
class.brief_description: Pre-baked 3D texture volumetric fog volume for fast static light shafts and localized fog.
class.description: Bakes local fog volumes, static light scattering, and ray-traced mesh shadows into a [Texture3D] resource sampled during [VolumetricFog] raymarching.
